script_text: A cosmic storm is reorganizing your foundations, Taurus, and nothing about your comfort zone stays untouched. Early week, Venus your ruling planet in Cancer forms a tense square to Saturn in your 11th House on Monday, sparking friendship friction but Tuesday brings a sweet Mercury sextile to your 2nd House, boosting career money talks. Midweek, the Sun enters your 4th House on Wednesday, shifting focus hard toward home and emotional security. Late week, Mars trine Pluto in your 10th House Thursday supercharges career ambition, while weekend Venus conjunct North Node in your 5th House ignites surprising new love or creative passion. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House of romance. Sunday is your worst day as Mercury opposite Neptune clouds financial contracts. Review bank statements before signing anything. Follow for daily updates.
